title: Sonic Knuckles Tails Shadow Hedgehog Metal Figures Metalfigs 4-piece set NIH
descriptionText: The product is a 4-piece set of metal figures featuring iconic characters from the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise, including Sonic, Knuckles, Tails, and Shadow. These figures are made of metal and are part of the Metalfigs series. Perfect for collectors and fans of the SEGA video game series.
